protocol.access: Tabular baselines use the same admitted typed fields as native rules/CatBoost; geometry baselines use the same supplied vectors as native regions. Geometry panels deliberately exclude oracle-coordinate tabular gates. Benefits are conditional on these input contracts.

definitions.error_blind_clusters: SciPy Lloyd k-means++, 16 centers, 20 iterations, seed zero; geometry only, no outcome input to fitting. One Voronoi cell per proposal.
definitions.low_order_rules: Existing predicate search, maximum depth two; same admitted node/candidate budget.
definitions.shallow_tree: One depth-two CPU CatBoost symmetric tree, same diagnostic target and categorical preprocessing.
definitions.simple_balls: Eight D geometry-coverage and eight high-loss observation centers, single balls at fixed D distance quantiles. No annuli, unions, PCA or graph.
definitions.single_diagnostic: One depth-four, 256-tree CPU CatBoost diagnostic model; D score quantiles/bands.

protocol.geometry: Original declared normalized vectors only in simpler baselines. Fit at most 20000 D vectors; shared frozen support radius from 1.5 times the .995 D nearest-center distance quantile. Unavailable H stays in planned recovery denominators.
protocol.inference: Independent H native effects are descriptive; no product confirmation or causal claim. Paired comparisons use independent fixed seed datasets and must report their uncertainty and comparison multiplicity. No presumed native superiority.
protocol.resources: Same product absolute thread/memory/deadline/workspace admission. Record actual fit/evaluation time and shared worker RSS. Concurrent-host time and shared peak RSS cannot establish controlled relative-efficiency ratios.
protocol.scope: Complementary-value evidence for these four error-rate archetypes only. Does not replace required objective-specific, overlap/stability/null/resource qualification or original unified full-shortlist recovery criteria.
protocol.selection: Shared native adverse-effect/support/complexity frontier on S; one first selected gate per method. No H/oracle choice. Native complete shortlist union is a separately labelled secondary result.
